ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar_v3.json is FanGraphs' published WAR from the frozen vintage plus the site's named departures; it moves only when it is rebuilt by hand.

team_basis.label: ewar board
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

coverage.rule: PA >= 100 or IP >= 30 on the StatsAPI season line

team_rollup.note: `war` is the eWAR of the players the club holds today, the basis every team board on this page is on; `war_earned` is the eWAR produced for the club this season, by stint. Hitters is the batting side of every player on the club; Starters, Relievers and Swing hold the pitching side by the player's role, the same start share the two pitcher boards pool on, and Swing also holds the mop-up inning of a position player, who is on neither pitcher board either. Each column rounds its own unrounded sum.

note: Batting plus pitching eWAR, summed before rounding, so a two-way player reads as a whole season and a swingman on neither pitcher board still appears. The sides are the ones the five player boards serve; the sum is stored only here.
